# Mili 1.1.8 — update progress in the tray

## What changed

- **The tray tooltip follows an update.** Hovering the tray icon now says what Mili is doing: checking, how far the download got, or that a new version is ready. Before, all of that was visible only with the panel open.
- **The release page starts with its heading.** The first line of the notes file is the release title, and the body now begins on the heading right after it instead of a stray blank line.

This release also exists to prove the 1.1.7 fix on a real update: 1.1.7 gave up the double download, so this page arrived after a single pass of the progress bar.

## Download

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Mili-Setup-1.1.8.exe** | Installer. Installs for your user, no admin rights, and keeps itself up to date. |
| **Mili-1.1.8-portable.exe** | Single file. Run it from anywhere, nothing is installed — updates are a manual download. |
| **latest.yml** + **Mili-Setup-1.1.8.exe.blockmap** | Update metadata that installed copies read. Leave them attached to the release. |

Requires Windows 10/11 and, for music, the Spotify desktop app.
